dimensions.note: No credential or secret handling. Global args are manifest paths, config-dir names, and a projectOwnedDirs allowlist.

Structured placeholder logging ('Inventoried {e} enrolled and {c} customized tool(s), {err} error(s), {w} warning(s)'); no interpolation and no secret values (config file contents are inventoried as paths, not bodies).

Missing or unparseable manifests are surfaced as explicit findings (unreadable-manifest) rather than throwing, which matches the model's job of reporting drift. File reads use readTextIfPresent and return null instead of throwing.

New agent_config_test.ts covers unquote(), parseEnrollment() (present and empty), and parseCustomTools() (tool definitions, null defaults, gitignoreEntries aggregation across tools, and empty input). The filesystem buildInventory path is not unit-tested.
Read-only inventory; reruns are idempotent and write no external state.
No external HTTP or network calls; local filesystem and regex parsing only.
Deno.readDir/readFile/stat only; no open connections, temp files, or unclosed handles.
README and tests use generic tool/config names (.claude, .codex, .kilo, .opencode) and .swamp paths. No real hostnames, IPs, or account identifiers.
All schemas are plain z.object(...) with no .passthrough(); CEL validation works.
inventory and drift resources plus the report file set lifetime 7d and garbageCollection 10.
Not a CRUD lifecycle model — it is a read-only inventory/drift analyzer.
No mutating methods, so no pre-flight gate is required.
inventory() writes inventory-current, drift-current, report-current; checkDrift() writes drift-current — same spec and shape, no collisions.
Stateless; reads no stored resources and uses no dataRepository access.
Bumped to 2026.10.14.1 and added a no-op upgrades entry (source moved to swamp-extensions; no schema changes) so existing instances advance their typeVersion.

mechanical.schema-write-conformance: pass — ToolSchema/ToolEntry fields (name, enrolled, customized, configDir, configDirExists, instructionsFile, instructionsExists, skillsDir, skillsDirExists, files) are all populated in the per-tool loop. InventorySchema fields match the buildInventory object; DriftReportSchema fields (projectDir, findings, errorCount, warningCount) all set.
mechanical.truncation-honesty: na — no paginated or result-capped method.
mechanical.instance-name-consistency: pass — drift-current is written by both inventory() and checkDrift() with an identical DriftReportSchema shape; inventory-current and report-current are written only by inventory().
mechanical.schema-field-coverage: pass — every declared field has a producing code path; nullable instruction/skills fields are set from the custom definition, and no placeholder writes were found.
